office: Procurement Division, Finance Department, City of Port Alder

goods_services.label: Micro-purchase
goods_services.requirement: One quote; P-card allowed up to $5,000; department approval.

goods_services.label: Informal quotes
goods_services.requirement: At least 3 written quotes; award to the lowest responsive quote; department head approval.

goods_services.label: Formal solicitation
goods_services.requirement: ITB (lowest responsive, responsible bidder) for clearly specified goods/services, RFP (best value) for complex services; advertised at least 14 calendar days; CPO approval.

construction.label: Micro-purchase
construction.requirement: One quote from a registered contractor.

construction.label: Informal quotes
construction.requirement: At least 3 written quotes from registered contractors.

construction.label: Formal ITB
construction.requirement: Sealed ITB advertised at least 21 calendar days; 5% bid bond enclosed with the bid; 100% performance and payment bonds; award to the lowest responsive, responsible bidder.

professional_services.label: Informal qualifications review
professional_services.requirement: Review of at least 3 firms' qualifications.

professional_services.label: Qualifications-based selection (QBS)
professional_services.requirement: Architecture/engineering/surveying: rank on qualifications only, then negotiate a fair price with the top-ranked firm; advertised at least 14 days.

local_preference.applies_to: ITBs for goods, services and construction; not applied to nationally funded projects
